definition: Gabriella Sanniti di Baja (born 29 January 1950) is a retired Italian computer scientist specializing in pattern recognition, including digital geometry and skeletonization.
details: Gabriella Sanniti di Baja (born 29 January 1950) is a retired Italian computer scientist specializing in pattern recognition, including digital geometry and skeletonization.

explainer.lead: Gabriella Sanniti di Baja is an Italian computer scientist. Her work spans informatics, computing, physics and pattern recognition.

timeline.what: Sanniti di Baja was a student at the University of Naples Federico II, where she completed a doctorate in 1973.
She is a former editor-in-chief of the journal Pattern Recognition Letters, and was president of the International Association for Pattern Recognition (IAPR) for the 2000–2002 term.
